local function XZEMEX_fake_script() -- Main.LocalScript 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', Main)

	local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
	local mainScreenGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("Main")
	
	local toggleKey = Enum.KeyCode.KeypadMinus
	
	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessedEvent)
		if input.KeyCode == toggleKey and not gameProcessedEvent then
			if mainScreenGui then
				mainScreenGui.Enabled = not mainScreenGui.Enabled
			end
		end
	end)
	
end
coroutine.wrap(XZEMEX_fake_script)()
